sources.name: O*NET 30.3 Database
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for the downloadable O*NET 30.3 Database, subject to O*NET license conditions and exceptions
sources.refresh_strategy: Prefer a pinned downloadable snapshot for reproducible/offline benchmark builds; optionally refresh through official API or current ZIP when explicitly enabled. Never make Buddy startup depend on O*NET network availability.
normalization: preserve source row identity where available
deduplicate alternate titles without deleting provenance
map tasks to DreamCo benchmark intents
map work activities to capability families
record source version and retrieval date

offline_behavior.when_source_unavailable: Use the most recent locally cached/pinned snapshot if present; otherwise skip authoritative workforce enrichment and continue with DreamCo-native benchmarks.
